sentences.en: The philosopher's stone could transmute every precious metal into gold.
sentences.zh: 哲学家石可以将每种贵重金属都转变成黄金。

sentences.en: Alchemists tried to transmute base metals into gold and silver.
sentences.zh: 炼金术士试图将普通金属转变为金银。

sentences.en: The old car was transmuted into a sleek sports model.
sentences.zh: 那辆旧车变成了一个流线型的跑车。

senses.zh: 使变形, 使变质, 把…变成…
